Hydrogen production costs 2021

This report presents levelised cost estimates for hydrogen production technologies, detailing methodology, data and assumptions.

From:
Department for Energy Security and Net Zero and Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy
Published:
17 August 2021
Get emails about this page
Documents
Hydrogen Production Costs 2021

PDF, 730 KB, 36 pages

Hydrogen Production Costs 2021 annex: Key assumptions and outputs for production technologies

MS Excel Spreadsheet, 2.02 MB

This file may not be suitable for users of assistive technology.

Request an accessible format
Details

This report presents levelised costs for hydrogen production technologies. A ‘levelised cost’ is the average cost over the lifetime of the plant per MWh of hydrogen produced. It reflects the cost of building and operating a generic plant for each technology. The report details the methodology, data and assumptions used to generate the levelised cost estimates.
